title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Rated Voltage up to 250V and Rated Current up to 16A — Specification

clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: IS 1293 specifies requirements for plugs and socket-outlets with rated voltage up to 250V and rated current up to 16A for household and similar general purposes. This standard is under compulsory ISI certification. Includes 3-pin 6A, 3-pin 16A, and universal configurations. All electrical plugs and sockets sold in India must bear the ISI mark.
